newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast crude off a tad, scheduling eases.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast crude off a tad, scheduling eases.

text.p: U.S. West Coast crude oil prices were a tad lower on Thursday amid a sharp drop in NYMEX futures and the near-end of scheduling, players said.
"This is a scheduling week. Most of the crudes have been scheduled and now players are putting their books to bed," said a West Coast crude seller.
The price for Alaskan North Slope (ANS) crude, the regional benchmark, remained unchanged at $2.16 under July West Texas Intermediate/Cushing (WTI) crude.
Line 63 barrels were down about 0.25 cent at $15.50 a barrel, but the differential to WTI/Cushing as well as Buena Vista remained unchanged.
